sentences.translation: 恐怕这已成了一个经济需求的问题。

sentences.translation: 疏于打理的花园

sentences.translation: 工厂里发生的事正在附近居民中私下传说。

sentences.sentence: a recurring nightmare

sentences.sentence: This week one of them will be nominated by the Democratic Party for the presidency of the United States.
sentences.translation: 本周他们中的一人将被民主党提名为美国总统职位的候选人。

sentences.sentence: She had no notion what he meant.
sentences.translation: 她根本不明白他是什么意思。

sentences.sentence: Wholemeal bread is more nutritious than white bread.
sentences.translation: 全麦面包比白面包更有营养。

sentences.sentence: Nuts and fruit make nutritious snacks.
sentences.translation: 坚果和水果是有营养价值的零食。

sentences.sentence: The cookbook contains many simple yet highly nutritious meals.
sentences.translation: 那本烹饪书里有许多简单却营养价值很高的食谱。

sentences.sentence: So, what of the future of obesity in America?
sentences.translation: 那么，未来美国的肥胖状况会怎么发展呢？

sentences.sentence: Dr.Watson is great on exercise as a cure for obesity.
sentences.translation: 沃森医生把运动看做是治疗肥胖症的良方。

sentences.sentence: What is obesity?
sentences.translation: 什么是肥胖？

sentences.sentence: He vowed to achieve certain objectives before the end of his presidency.
sentences.translation: 他立誓要在他的总统任期结束之前实现某些目标。

sentences.sentence: the best way to accomplish your objectives
sentences.translation: 完成目标的最佳方法

sentences.sentence: The degree program has two main objectives.
sentences.translation: 该学位课程有两个主要目标。

sentences.sentence: Managers should set specific performance objectives for their teams.
sentences.translation: 经理应该为自己的团队制定明确的绩效目标。

sentences.sentence: The main objective was to improve children’s knowledge of geography.
sentences.translation: 主要目的是要增长儿童的地理知识。

sentences.sentence: A clear objective was set and adhered to.
sentences.translation: 定下了明确的目标并坚持到底。

sentences.sentence: One of your first business objectives should be to get your own office.
sentences.translation: 你的首要工作目标之一应该是拥有自己的办公室。

sentences.sentence: The storm got worse and worse. Finally, I was obliged to abandon the car and continue on foot.
sentences.translation: 暴风雨越来越猛烈。最终，我被迫弃车徒步前行。

sentences.sentence: The tax puts obstacles in the way of companies trying to develop trade overseas.
sentences.translation: 这项税收为想在海外发展贸易的公司设置了障碍。

sentences.sentence: Women still have to overcome many obstacles to gain equality.
sentences.translation: 妇女要获得平等仍需克服重重障碍。

sentences.sentence: We want to remove all obstacles to travel between the two countries.
sentences.translation: 我们想要消除在这两个国家之间旅行的所有障碍。

sentences.sentence: the single biggest obstacle to a Conservative victory in the next election
sentences.translation: 保守党在下一届大选中获胜的最大障碍

sentences.sentence: There are formidable obstacles on the road to peace.
sentences.translation: 通往和平的道路上存在难以逾越的障碍。

sentences.sentence: A third of accidental deaths occur in the home.
sentences.translation: 有三分之一的意外死亡发生在家里。

sentences.sentence: The explosion occurred at 5.30 a.m.
sentences.translation: 爆炸发生在清晨5点30分。

phrases.translation: 犯罪行为，犯罪；刑事犯罪

sentences.sentence: His words gave great offense to everybody present.
sentences.translation: 他的发言冲犯了在场的所有人。

sentences.sentence: These efforts have led to a growing confidence among the public that corruption is a serious punishable offense in Albania.
sentences.translation: 这些努力增强了公众的信心，即人们相信，腐败在阿尔巴尼亚是严重犯罪，能够受到惩罚。

sentences.sentence: Congress is continuing to oppose the President’s health care budget.
sentences.translation: 国会继续反对总统的医疗保健预算。

phrases.translation: 二元对立；二项对立；相对关系
反对派领袖；反对党领导

sentences.sentence: He is confident in his ability to overcome all opposition with his personal charm.
sentences.translation: 他自信有能力以个人魅力来化解一切反对力量。

sentences.sentence: The proposals have aroused the opposition of teachers.
sentences.translation: 这些建议引起了教师们的反对。

sentences.sentence: Strong opposition resulted in rejection of the bill.
sentences.translation: 在强烈反对下这项议案遭到否决。

sentences.sentence: Plans to turn the site into a £600 million leisure complex have met with stiff opposition.
sentences.translation: 将该处改造成造价六亿英镑的综合性休闲大楼的计划遭到了激烈的反对。

sentences.sentence: Much public opposition to the new law remained.
sentences.translation: 公众对这项新法律仍存在普遍的反对情绪。

sentences.sentence: Workers found themselves in opposition to local interests.
sentences.translation: 工人们发现自己与当地人的利益存在冲突。

sentences.sentence: Andrew took a more optimistic view.
sentences.translation: 安德鲁抱有更为乐观的想法。

text:
英语词汇 · 六级 · 第 25 单元

necessity
音标：英 /nəˈsesəti/  美 /nə'sɛsəti/
n. 必须，必要性
短语：of necessity — 必然地；不可避免地
短语：out of necessity — 出于需要，必定
短语：by necessity — 不得已；必然地，不可避免地
短语：logical necessity — 必然性，逻辑的必然性
例句：I’m afraid it’s become a matter of economic necessity.
恐怕这已成了一个经济需求的问题。

needy
音标：英 /'ni:dɪ/  美 /'nidi/
adj. 贫穷的
短语：needy student — 家庭经济困难的学生
例句：a needy family
贫困家庭

neglect
音标：英 /nɪ'ɡlekt/  美 /nɪ'glɛkt/
v. 忽视
短语：neglect of — 疏忽
短语：neglect of duty — 玩忽职守；[法]失职；过失责任
例句：She smoked and drank, neglected the children, and left the clothes unmended.
她抽烟喝酒，既不照顾孩子，也不缝补衣服。
例句：a neglected garden
疏于打理的花园
例句：The building has been badly neglected.
这栋大楼严重疏于维护。

negotiation
音标：英 /nɪˌgəʊʃiˈeɪʃn/  美 /nɪ,ɡoʃɪ'eʃən/
n. 协商
短语：business negotiation — 商务谈判，商业谈判；交易磋商
短语：contract negotiation — 合同谈判
短语：negotiation skill — 谈判技巧
短语：trade negotiation — 贸易谈判；贸易洽谈
短语：negotiation bank — [金融]议付银行
短语：negotiation credit — 议付信用证；信用状的协商
例句：The trader was obstinate in the negotiation.
这个商人在谈判中拗强固执。

neighborhood
音标：英 /'neɪbəhʊd/  美 /'nebɚ,hʊd/
n. 附近
短语：in the neighborhood of — 在…附近；大约
短语：neighborhood committee — 居委会；街道委员会
短语：neighborhood park — 邻里公园
短语：residential neighborhood — 住所的邻里
例句：What happened in the factory is being whispered about the neighborhood.
工厂里发生的事正在附近居民中私下传说。

neutrality
音标：英 /nju:ˈtræləti/  美 /nu'træləti/
n. 中立
例句：Net neutrality, or not?
网络中立或不?
例句：Some of the nations declared neutrality.
有的国家宣布中立。
例句：Yet in our view, the notion of “search neutrality” threatens innovation, competition and, fundamentally,your ability as a user to improve how you find information.
但在我们看来“搜索中立”这个概念威胁创新，竞争和本质上的，你作为一个用户去提高你寻找信息的能力。

nightmare
音标：英 /ˈnaɪtmeə(r)/  美 /'naɪt'mɛr/
n. 噩梦
例句：a recurring nightmare 
一再出现的噩梦

nominate
音标：英 /'nɒmɪneɪt/  美 /'nɑmɪnet/
v. 提名
例句：This week one of them will be nominated by the Democratic Party for the presidency of the United States.
本周他们中的一人将被民主党提名为美国总统职位的候选人。

notion
音标：英 /ˈnəuʃən/  美 /'noʃən/
n. 想法，观点
例句：She had no notion what he meant.
她根本不明白他是什么意思。

numerous
音标：英 /ˈnju:mərəs/  美 /'numərəs/
adj. 无数的

nutritious
音标：英 /njuˈtrɪʃəs/  美 /nʊ'trɪʃəs/
adj. 有营养的
例句：Wholemeal bread is more nutritious than white bread.
全麦面包比白面包更有营养。
例句：Nuts and fruit make nutritious snacks.
坚果和水果是有营养价值的零食。
例句：The cookbook contains many simple yet highly nutritious meals.
那本烹饪书里有许多简单却营养价值很高的食谱。

obesity
音标：英 /əʊ'bi:sətɪ/  美 /o'bisəti/
n. 肥胖
短语：morbid obesity — 病态肥胖
例句：So, what of the future of obesity in America?
那么，未来美国的肥胖状况会怎么发展呢？
例句：Dr.Watson is great on exercise as a cure for obesity.
沃森医生把运动看做是治疗肥胖症的良方。
例句：What is obesity?
什么是肥胖？

objective
音标：英 /əbˈdʒektɪv/  美 /əb'dʒɛktɪv/
n. 目标，目的
短语：objective function — 目标函数
短语：objective analysis — 目标分析，客观分析
短语：objective evaluation — 客观评价
短语：strategic objective — 战略目标
短语：ultimate objective — 最终目标；最极目标
短语：objective laws — 客观规律
短语：objective evidence — 客观证据
短语：objective condition — 客观条件；客观情况
短语：objective factor — 客观因素；物的因素
短语：objective lens — 物镜
短语：general objective — 一般目标，总目标
短语：job objective — 工作目标；求职意向
短语：management by objective — 目标管理；目标治理
短语：objective value — 客观价值
短语：objective test — 客观测验；客观式测验
短语：investment objective — 投资目标
短语：objective knowledge — 客观知识；客观认识；客观熟悉
短语：objective cause — 客观原因
短语：performance objective — 绩效目标
短语：social objective — 社会目标
例句：He vowed to achieve certain objectives before the end of his presidency.
他立誓要在他的总统任期结束之前实现某些目标。
例句：the best way to accomplish your objectives
完成目标的最佳方法
例句：The degree program has two main objectives.
该学位课程有两个主要目标。
例句：Managers should set specific performance objectives for their teams.
经理应该为自己的团队制定明确的绩效目标。
例句：The main objective was to improve children’s knowledge of geography.
主要目的是要增长儿童的地理知识。
例句：A clear objective was set and adhered to.
定下了明确的目标并坚持到底。
例句：One of your first business objectives should be to get your own office.
你的首要工作目标之一应该是拥有自己的办公室。

oblige
音标：英 /ə'blaɪdʒ/  美 /ə'blaɪdʒ/
v. 迫使
例句：The storm got worse and worse. Finally, I was obliged to abandon the car and continue on foot.
暴风雨越来越猛烈。最终，我被迫弃车徒步前行。

obstacle
音标：英 /ˈɒbstəkl/  美 /'ɑbstəkl/
n. 阻碍
短语：obstacle course — n. 超越障碍训练场
例句：The tax puts obstacles in the way of companies trying to develop trade overseas.
这项税收为想在海外发展贸易的公司设置了障碍。
例句：Women still have to overcome many obstacles to gain equality.
妇女要获得平等仍需克服重重障碍。
例句：We want to remove all obstacles to travel between the two countries.
我们想要消除在这两个国家之间旅行的所有障碍。
例句：the single biggest obstacle to a Conservative victory in the next election
保守党在下一届大选中获胜的最大障碍
例句：There are formidable obstacles on the road to peace.
通往和平的道路上存在难以逾越的障碍。

occur
音标：英 /əˈkɜ:(r)/  美 /ə'kɝ/
v. 发生
短语：occur as — 以...的形式出现
短语：occur for — 发生在…时候
例句：A third of accidental deaths occur in the home.
有三分之一的意外死亡发生在家里。
例句：The explosion occurred at 5.30 a.m.
爆炸发生在清晨5点30分。

offense
音标：英 /əˈfens/  美 /ə'fɛns/
n. 冒犯
短语：no offense — 无意冒犯；请勿见怪
短语：criminal offense — 犯罪行为，犯罪；刑事犯罪
短语：take offense — 生气
短语：offense and defense — 攻与守
例句：His words gave great offense to everybody present.
他的发言冲犯了在场的所有人。
例句：These efforts have led to a growing confidence among the public that corruption is a serious punishable offense in Albania.
这些努力增强了公众的信心，即人们相信，腐败在阿尔巴尼亚是严重犯罪，能够受到惩罚。

oppose
音标：英 /ə'pəʊz/  美 /ə'poz/
v. 反对
例句：Congress is continuing to oppose the President’s health care budget.
国会继续反对总统的医疗保健预算。

opposition
音标：英 /ˌɒpəˈzɪʃn/  美 /'ɑpə'zɪʃən/
n. 反对
短语：in opposition to — 反对；与…相反
短语：opposition party — 反对党；在野党
短语：binary opposition — 二元对立；二项对立；相对关系
短语：leader of the opposition — 反对派领袖；反对党领导
例句：He is confident in his ability to overcome all opposition with his personal charm.
他自信有能力以个人魅力来化解一切反对力量。
例句：The proposals have aroused the opposition of teachers.
这些建议引起了教师们的反对。
例句：Strong opposition resulted in rejection of the bill.
在强烈反对下这项议案遭到否决。
例句：Plans to turn the site into a £600 million leisure complex have met with stiff opposition.
将该处改造成造价六亿英镑的综合性休闲大楼的计划遭到了激烈的反对。
例句：Much public opposition to the new law remained.
公众对这项新法律仍存在普遍的反对情绪。
例句：Workers found themselves in opposition to local interests.
工人们发现自己与当地人的利益存在冲突。

optimistic
音标：英 /ˌɒptɪˈmɪstɪk/  美 /,ɑptɪ'mɪstɪk/
adj. 乐观的
短语：cautiously optimistic — 审慎乐观
短语：optimistic estimate — 乐观估计；最乐观时间
例句：Andrew took a more optimistic view.
安德鲁抱有更为乐观的想法。
